item.description: MOORHEAD, Minn. (KVRR) – The owner of a Moorhead brewery has been invited to President Trump’s State of the Union Address Tuesday. item.description: FARGO, N.D. — People living in downtown Fargo are being urged to remove vehicles from streets tonight for snow removal. item.title: Vikings team up with Fargo Park District to create high school girls flag football program
item.description: FARGO — The Fargo Park District is teaming up with the Minnesota Vikings to start a high school girls flag football pilot program. The program will be available to high school girls from Fargo, West Fargo, Moorhead, and the surrounding towns.
